mentions.name: SleepSignal
mentions.description: This app helps people fall asleep by playing short imaginative audio prompts (e.g., "moonlight on a white flower") instead of music or long podcasts; the listener closes their eyes, visualizes each scenario until the next one appears, with sessions such as a 10-minute wind-down.
mentions.problem: Music or long podcasts may not be ideal for falling asleep; this offers imagination-based audio prompts as an alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Recently worked on https://sleepsignal.app
.
Instead of music or long podcasts, you are given something to imagine. Like if you hear "moonlight on a white flower", imagine that scenario until you hear the next one.
.
Simply close your eyes, listen and imagine
.
Try a 10-minute session tonight
